name: All-Over Print Polo Shirt
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality bird-eye pique fabric blended with 3–5% spandex, offering a breathable, soft, and flexible wearing experience.
    - The bird-eye pique texture helps improve airflow and gives the shirt a clean, sporty, and structured appearance.
    - Added spandex provides light stretch for improved comfort and ease of movement during everyday wear.
    - Designed with a classic polo collar and button placket for a polished yet casual look.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes from S to 5XL.
    📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Vibrant all-over sublimation print: With full-color sublimation, your designs stay bold, fade-resistant, and eye-catching.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a personalized polo shirt and a versatile everyday wardrobe piece.
    - Suitable for casual outings, sports events, workwear, family trips, team activities, barbecues, holidays, and daily wear.
    - The breathable bird-eye pique fabric helps provide comfort in warm weather.
    - The slight spandex blend allows for easier movement and a more comfortable fit.
    - Great for custom group shirts, themed events, business uniforms, and gift giving.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for dads, husbands, boyfriends, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Father’s Day, holidays, team events, company outings, reunions, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves custom apparel with a bold full-print design.
    - Great for patriotic themes, BBQ parties, sports groups, travel wear, and family matching outfits.
    - A stylish and practical gift that combines comfort, personality, and standout design.
    - Adds a bold, sporty, and memorable touch to everyday wear 👕

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x All-Over Print Polo Shirt

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as an .emb, .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
